description: Lists the image IDs inside image group (DGS) 7561840, one of the three reels of koha:186990, Ayling's 'Revised register of the soldiers and sailors of New Hampshire in the War of the Rebellion, 1861-1866' (film 1697872). Captured live 2026-11-27 with dev/try-image-search.ts 7561840. Drives ut_search_images_np2: a DGS taken from catalog_search's film notes has real page images, so the agent must not say none are digitized. The substring predicate matches both the bare '7561840' and the zero-padded '007561840'. 1439 images.
